hold_reasoning: Nothing to trade, and cash rules out any new entry. Cash is EUR 221.29 and the floor is EUR 150, so only about EUR 71 is free. The smallest entry is EUR 250, so no BUY can be placed without first selling something. The two strongest notes come from sharp-shooter-eur and world. Sharp-shooter-eur is at 7/10 on HEN3.DE, which made a 52-week closing high on 2.3x volume. World is at 6/10 on AI.PA, a euro defensive-quality name. These are new ideas. To fund one I would have to sell a working position, and that would use both of this week's trades for a thesis that was confirmed only one day ago. HEN3 closed at 87.36, just under the analyst's own 87.5 hold level, so the breakout is not confirmed yet. No held thesis is breaking. On 4GLD.DE (116.06), goldfinger holds the core in the 112-120 range, and the 112 break level is far away. Satoshi keeps the BTC-EUR core: price is 67,030, above the 65.9k markdown-extension level, and the position is worth EUR 368.66, under the EUR 400 cap. AIR.PA and ALV.DE are both above cost. PHAG.L is about 15% under cost, but goldfinger is holding silver as a secondary position, not exiting it. Loss harvesting waits for December. NVDA is about 23% under cost in USD. No analyst covers it with reduce or exit, and yolo-sapiens' Nasdaq bear view is unconfirmed (no close under 656), so no exit is triggered. December loss harvesting is the planned review point for NVDA and PHAG.L. No position is over the EUR 400 cap. The SLB remainder is worth EUR 0.15. The EUR 1.25 IBIE fee floor is about 8x what selling it would bring in, and the sale would use a trade slot, so I leave it as an ignored zero-weight remainder. It is not a real sixth or seventh position. The default is HOLD.
